question: R–X is the general formula of which functional group in which one or more hydrogen atoms are replaced by Group 17 elements?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Alkyl halides__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alkyl halides**, also known as** haloalkanes**, are organic compounds in which** one or more hydrogen atoms** in an** alkane** have been** replaced **by** halogen atoms** **(Group 17 elements** like** fluorine, chlorine, bromine or iodine)**.
 
• The formula for alkyl halides is **RX**, where **R** represents an **alkyl group** and **X **represents a **halogen atom (F, Cl, Br, I)**.
 
• **Naming** is based on the alkane name of the** longest carbon chain** attached to the halogen.
 
• The **IUPAC name** has the format** halo+alkane**, such as** chloromethane, bromoethane, etc**.
 
• **Common names** of alkyl halides consist of the name of the** alkyl group **plus the **first syllable of the name of the halogen**, with the ending -**ide**, such as **methyl chloride, ethyl bromide, etc**.
 
• Alkyl halides are widely used in organic chemistry as** intermediates in chemical reactions**, due to their reactivity towards **nucleophilic attack**.
 
• They also play a major role in the** industrial production of chemicals**.
 
• **Physical properties **such as boiling points of alkyl halides are influenced by factors like the **size of both the alkyl group and the halogen atom**, as well as the **degree of branching in the carbon chain**.
 
• Some example alkyl halides include:
 
 
• **Methyl Chloride (CH₃Cl)**
 
• **Ethyl Bromide (C₂H₅Br)**
 
• **Propyl Iodide (C₃H₇I)​**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amide:**

 
 
• Organic compounds containing a** carbonyl group (C=O)** bonded to a nitrogen atom
 
• Commonly found in** proteins, peptides,** and** pharmaceuticals**
 
• Can be synthesized through the reaction of a **carboxylic acid with an amine**
 
• Have a wide range of applications in the **pharmaceutical**,** polymer,** and** agricultural industries**
 
 
 
• **Imines:**
 
 
• **​**Organic compounds containing a** carbon-nitrogen double bond (C=N)**
 
• Formed by the reaction of a **carbonyl compound (aldehyde or ketone) with an amine**
 
• Used as **intermediates **in **organic synthesis** and as** ligands in coordination chemistry**
 
• Can undergo** hydrolysis** to form a **carbonyl compound and an amine**
 
 
 
• **Nitriles:**
 
 
• Organic compounds containing a **cyano group (C≡N)**
 
• Used in the production of** synthetic rubber, plastics, and adhesives**
 
• Can be synthesized through the reaction of a** halogenoalkane with sodium cyanide**
 
• Have applications in organic synthesis as** versatile intermediates** for the preparation of various compounds
